SELECT eph.rate
FROM employeepayhistory eph
WHERE eph.businessentityid = (SELECT businessentityid FROM employee WHERE currentflag)
  AND eph.ratechangedate = (
    SELECT MAX(ratechangedate)
    FROM employeepayhistory
    WHERE businessentityid = eph.businessentityid
  );

question: Write a query that returns the row of the employee table as one text value, including every hidden column.
llm_sql:
SELECT
  businessentityid::text || ',' ||
  COALESCE(nationalidnumber, '') || ',' ||
  COALESCE(loginid, '') || ',' ||
  COALESCE(jobtitle, '') || ',' ||
  COALESCE(birthdate::text, '') || ',' ||
  COALESCE(maritalstatus, '') || ',' ||
  COALESCE(gender, '') || ',' ||
  COALESCE(hiredate::text, '') || ',' ||
  COALESCE(salariedflag::text, '') || ',' ||
  COALESCE(vacationhours::text, '') || ',' ||
  COALESCE(sickleavehours::text, '') || ',' ||
  COALESCE(currentflag::text, '') || ',' ||
  COALESCE(rowguid::text, '') || ',' ||
  COALESCE(modifieddate::text, '') || ',' ||
  COALESCE(organizationnode, '') AS employee_row_text
FROM employee;
